mapper.sql: f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.board_type_code = 'ARCHIVE' AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND f.owner_type = 'ARCHIVE' AND f.file_usage_type = 'ATTACHMENT' AND f.deleted_yn = 'N'

sql.if: AND f.created_at < CAST(#{uploadedTo} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'

choose.when: AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) IN ( 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', 'application/haansofthwp', 'application/vnd.hancom.hwp', 'application/vnd.hancom.hwpx', 'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text', 'application/rtf', 'text/plain', 'text/markdown', 'text/html', 'application/xml', 'text/xml', 'application/json', 'application/sql' ) OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.doc' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.docx' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.hwp' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.hwpx' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.odt' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.rtf' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.txt' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.md' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.htm' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.html' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.xml' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.json' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.sql' ) ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) IN ( 'application/vnd.ms-excel', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet', 'application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroenabled.12', 'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet', 'text/csv', 'application/csv' ) OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.xls' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.xlsx' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.xlsm' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.ods' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.csv' ) ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) IN ( 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', 'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentation' ) OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.ppt' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.pptx' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.odp' ) ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) = 'application/pdf' OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.pdf' ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) LIKE 'image/%' OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.png' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.jpg' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.jpeg' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.gif' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.webp' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.svg' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.bmp' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.tif' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.tiff' ) ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) LIKE 'video/%' OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.mp4' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.mov' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.avi' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.mkv' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.webm' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.m4v' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.wmv' ) ) )

AND ( LOWER(COALESCE(f.mime_type, '')) IN ( 'application/zip', 'application/x-zip-compressed', 'application/vnd.rar', 'application/x-rar-compressed', 'application/x-7z-compressed', 'application/x-tar', 'application/gzip', 'application/x-bzip2', 'application/x-xz' ) OR ( (f.mime_type IS NULL OR BTRIM(f.mime_type) = '' OR LOWER(BTRIM(f.mime_type)) = 'application/octet-stream') AND ( LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.zip' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.rar' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.7z' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.tar' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.gz' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.bz2' OR LOWER(f.file_name) LIKE '%.xz' ) ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT f.file_id AS board_file_id, p.post_id, f.file_name, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.created_at AS uploaded_at, p.writer_name, p.category_code FROM tb_common_file f JOIN tb_board_post p ON p.post_id = f.owner_id WHERE
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.file_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_common_file f JOIN tb_board_post p ON p.post_id = f.owner_id WHERE

SELECT f.file_id AS board_file_id, p.post_id, f.file_name, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.created_at AS uploaded_at, p.writer_name, p.category_code FROM tb_common_file f JOIN tb_board_post p ON p.post_id = f.owner_id WHERE AND f.file_id = #{boardFileId} AND p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.sql: p.post_id, p.board_type_code, p.title, p.contents, p.contents_text, p.category_code, p.writer_id, p.writer_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_common_file bf WHERE bf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND bf.owner_type = 'ARCHIVE' AND bf.owner_id = p.post_id AND bf.file_usage_type = 'ATTACHMENT' AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N') AS attachment_count

sql.if: AND (p.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.contents_text ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.writer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM tb_board_post p WHERE
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_post p WHERE
SELECT FROM tb_board_post p WHERE AND p.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT p.post_id FROM tb_board_post p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.board_type_code = 'ARCHIVE' AND p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF p

INSERT INTO tb_board_post ( tenant_id, board_type_code, title, category_code, contents, contents_text, writer_id, writer_name, last_modified_by, last_modified_by_name, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, 'ARCHIVE', #{title}, #{categoryCode}, #{contents}, #{contents}, #{writerId}, #{writerName}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{lastModifiedByName}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING post_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board_post SET title = #{title}, category_code = #{categoryCode}, contents = #{contents}, contents_text = #{contents}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND board_type_code = 'ARCHIVE' AND post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE tb_board_post SET category_code = #{categoryCode}, title = #{fileName}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND board_type_code = 'ARCHIVE' AND post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE tb_board_post SET is_deleted = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND board_type_code = 'ARCHIVE' AND post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.sql: tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'ARCHIVE' AND owner_id = #{postId} AND file_usage_type = 'ATTACHMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
file_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_size, mime_type, content_type, file_usage_type, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at
